run_crash_avoidance: run the locobot kobuki crash avoidance controller with a PyRobot and crash detection model
download_if_not_present: download a crash detection model file from a URL if it is not already present locally
go_straight: make a PyRobot locobot move forward at a specified velocity for a given duration
turn_left: make a PyRobot locobot turn left at a specified angular velocity for a given duration
turn_right: make a PyRobot locobot turn right at a specified angular velocity for a given duration
